parsed.public_message: If I name a truce, I will keep it to the letter. I will not pretend we can share the victory.
parsed.explanation: Macedon is the strongest hill army here: cheap Cretan archers, cheap Rhodian slingers, pikes against cavalry, and Alexander. Carthage is the counter if someone else takes Macedon — Balearic slingers, Numidian cavalry, and a cheap spear line can flank a pike-and-archer block. Persia is the third choice for Parthian horse archers, Immortals, and cheap Cardaces, a mobile ranged army with Cyrus or Darius.
